records.issue_text: src/sentry/integrations/github/integration.py:487: The except Integration.DoesNotExist branch advances the pipeline without verifying that the authenticated GitHub user owns the installation, allowing a user to submit another installation’s ID and bypass authorization when its local record has not yet been created.
records.rationale: The finding correctly identifies a security vulnerability. Looking at the GitHubInstallation.dispatch method around line 487, when Integration.DoesNotExist is caught, the code calls `return pipeline.next_step()` without verifying the authenticated GitHub user. The verification check (comparing `github_authenticated_user` to `integration.metadata['sender']['login']`) only happens in the else branch
